title: Project Manager - Energy and Mobility Solutions
description:

title: QA/QC Manager - Owner's Representative - Utility-Scale Renewable Energy
description:
**Position Overview**

Axial Energy Services is seeking an experienced QA/QC Manager to serve as the Owner's Representative on utility-scale solar and battery energy storage (BESS) projects. This role is responsible for field oversight in ensuring that solar installations meet company standards, engineering specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices throughout the project lifecycle. The successful candidate will work closely with EPC contractors, inspectors, and project stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, drive corrective actions, and ensure successful project delivery.

This position requires temporary residence near the project site for the duration of the assignment. Axial provides mobilization assistance, per diem, and a company vehicle with fuel reimbursement.

*\*\*This is an owner's oversight and construction management role and is not a craft construction position.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee quality assurance and quality control programs, as well as inspection processes
* Verify compliance with project specifications, drawings, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor quality documentation, inspection reports, testing activities, NCRs, and corrective actions.
* Identify deficiencies and work with contractors to resolve issues before they impact schedule or project performance.
* Support commissioning, punch list management, turnover, and project closeout activities.
* Foster strong working relationships among project stakeholders while maintaining the owner's interests throughout project execution.
* Champion an industry-leading safety culture and ensure all project participants maintain compliance with site-specific safety requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of QA/QC experience in utility-scale solar, BESS, power generation, transmission, substation, or heavy industrial construction.
* Strong understanding of construction quality processes, inspections, testing, and turnover requirements.

title: Manager III, Battery Manufacturing Engineering
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a Manager of Battery Manufacturing Engineering to build the team and the manufacturing systems that produce battery assemblies for our next-generation robotics products. These are compact, high-energy battery packs that must be safe, light and reliable, with tight packaging of cells, interconnects, thermal management, sensing and battery management electronics. You will lead a team of manufacturing engineers and own battery manufacturing end to end, partnering with design engineering from early concept. You will define the manufacturing line, develop the equipment technologies and processes it needs, and own the roadmap through deployment of safe, robust, high-volume automated lines.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, develop and lead a team of manufacturing engineers, setting clear goals, priorities and career growth for each person.
* Own the battery manufacturing roadmap, staffing plan and capital budget, aligning them with product and program milestones.
* Lead DFM, DFA and design-for-test reviews from initial concept, shaping cell, module and pack architecture for safe, automated assembly.
* Ideate and deliver battery manufacturing systems from proof of concept to automation at scale, defining assembly sequence, station design, line balancing and layout.
* Lead the development of new equipment technologies and bring key battery processes to maturity, including cell handling and sorting, interconnect welding, adhesive and thermal interface dispensing, potting, sealing and fastening.
* Co-define and deploy quality and safety controls (incoming cell inspection, in-process inspection, leak, isolation and electrical end-of-line test, and cell-level traceability) with design, test, quality and safety engineering.

---------------

The Manager is the accountable owner for projects once they are approved for development, reducing 3CE's reliance on vendors and developers and retaining project knowledge within the agency. title: Senior Manager, Acquisitions
description:
